    • Reach new potential customers
    • Retarget previous website visitors
    • Increase brand recall
    • Support product launches

    Frequently Asked Question

    Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

    Display advertising refers to visual ads (banners, images, interactive creatives) that appear on websites, apps, and digital platforms. These ads help increase brand visibility, drive website traffic, and generate leads by targeting users based on their interests, behavior, and demographics.

    Search advertising targets users who are actively searching for specific keywords. Display advertising, on the other hand, reaches users while they are browsing online, helping build brand awareness and re-engage potential customers before they search.

    Display advertising works well for businesses that want to increase brand awareness, promote new products, retarget website visitors, or scale lead generation. It is effective for startups, growing brands, and established businesses across industries.

    We run campaigns across platforms such as the Google Display Network (GDN), programmatic ad networks, mobile apps, and relevant industry websites to ensure maximum reach and targeting precision.

    We use advanced targeting options including interest-based targeting, in-market audiences, custom intent audiences, remarketing lists, demographic targeting, and geographic segmentation to ensure your ads reach the most relevant users.
